682:t_2:109.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's why $$ノノ$$... thought she would forget about $$ノノリリ$$ and go on living...」

682:t_2:110.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's a lie! You always gave it everything you had! With hard work and guts!」

682:t_2:111.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You left me behind, and I fell into despair, but you kept moving forward!」

682:t_2:112.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's why I... You shone so brightly to me...」

682:t_2:113.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But Big Sis kept fighting... You never ran away, and fought with hard work and guts...」

682:t_2:114.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's why Big Sis really is $$ノノリリ$$... the person I admire.」

682:t_2:116.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...I'm always... like this, really... $$ノノ$$ really is hopeless...」

682:t_2:117.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No matter how much power $$ノノ$$ gains, she's still just a flame... When a strong wind blows, she immediately wavers.」

682:t_2:118.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But if Big Sis were here with me...」

682:t_3:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
(Of course... Now that I've lost my $$トップレス$$ abilities, $$ディスヌフ$$ has no power source left...)

682:t_3:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
(It's lonely being alone, $$ディスヌフ$$...)

682:t_3:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
(...But $$ノノ$$ is... fighting alone... even though she's actually scared...)

682:t_3:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$...! Can you... still move...?!」

682:t_3:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You... want to help $$ノノ$$ too, don't you...」

682:t_3:10.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...It may be worth trying what $$カシオ$$ told me before...」

682:t_3:11.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$'s sealed power... I'll... use it!」

682:t_4:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm sorry, Big Sis... $$ノノ$$ didn't understand... how you felt at all.」

682:t_4:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's not true! I was just being selfish!」

682:t_4:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I... was jealous of your power, and charged ahead on my own... I don't deserve to have you call me Big Sis...」

682:t_4:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's not true! Big Sis is still Big Sis!」

682:t_4:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No, $$ラルク$$... $$ラルク$$ will always be $$ノノ$$'s friend and Big Sis.」

682:t_4:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm sorry! I get too embarrassed, so I'm going to keep calling you Big Sis!」

682:t_4:11.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...But... we have to say goodbye.」

682:t_4:13.en:
$$ノノ$$
「As long as you never give up, your wish will come true someday.」

682:t_4:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Even if $$ノノ$$ vanishes at the end of causality, people will someday be able to control even time.」

682:t_4:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You... wanted to be an ordinary girl, didn't you...?」

682:t_4:16.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I thought I'd be able to live that way once the fighting was over.」

682:t_4:17.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then come with me, so you can! We'll end the fighting with our combined power!」

682:t_4:18.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But $$ノノ$$... has to do something about this singularity...」

682:t_4:19.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Are you going to go off somewhere all alone like that?」

682:t_4:21.en:
$$カズミ$$
「So this is how 《$$ユング#keyword$$》 felt when she saw us off back then.」

682:t_4:22.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ユング・フロイト$$... She was the first president of the $$銀河連邦$$.」

682:t_4:23.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So $$ユング#pilot$$ really moves up in the world...」

682:t_4:24.en:
$$ノノ$$
「President $$ユング#pilot$$ believed you would return someday after disappearing into the black hole, and she prepared something for you.」

682:t_4:30.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It's a message to welcome us back... It's so big, and so beautiful...」

682:t_4:32.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It looks like they made a mistake in the rush to finish it...」

682:t_4:33.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...One of $$ノノ$$'s duties was to welcome you back and activate that message.」

682:t_4:34.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So that's why you were so opposed to ramming $$翠の地球$$ into it.」

682:t_4:35.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That wasn't the only reason. It was for all the people who fought to protect the Earth...」

682:t_4:36.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And for the people alive today who love that planet...」

682:t_4:38.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...It's strange. Seeing that message makes my heart waver, even though I'd decided to leave...」

682:t_4:39.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Without Big Sis, $$ノノ$$ really is like a tiny flame flickering in the wind.」

682:t_4:40.en:
$$カズミ$$
「You can come home, $$ノノ$$. Take a look at the naked singularity you're holding.」

682:t_4:42.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The force that seeks to exist has suppressed the force that seeks to vanish.」

682:t_4:43.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You can come home! Now you can come home, $$ノノ$$!」

682:t_4:45.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Now I understand what $$ＡＧ$$ meant... when he said $$翠の地球$$ is a planet that's always waiting for someone to return.」

682:t_4:46.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The people who went to the moon... The people who journeyed even farther into space, even abandoning their human forms...」

682:t_4:47.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The people who vanished with the oceans in the $$時空震動$$... The people who fought to protect the Earth...」

682:t_4:48.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The feelings within that planet, waiting for someone for 12,000 long years, didn't want to see another goodbye...」

682:t_4:49.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$... can come home...? It's all right to come home?」

682:t_4:50.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Yes... We'll always be together from now on, $$ノノ$$!」

682:t_4:51.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, Big Sis...! We'll be together forever and ever!」

682:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I never imagined you would appear here.」

682:t_10:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The time has come for us both to fulfill our long-held wishes. I can at least say hello.」

682:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're right. ...Though I certainly never expected it to take this form...」

682:t_10:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then I'll be going... I'll be waiting for you to come.」

682:t_10:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「In their universe... $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

682:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Cursed wanderer... The end of your journey is close now...」

682:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...But I have no time to get sentimental. Our moment of truth is finally here too.」

682:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And so, we'll have to postpone our celebration of the ace pilots until the next opportunity.」

682:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will remain open for business! And of course, I haven't forgotten this either!」

682:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all today too... Business, business!」

683:t_000:0.en:
$$ニア$$
「We've broken through the $$宇宙怪獣$$' defensive line!」

683:t_000:1.en:
$$リーロン$$
「We've lost 35 percent of our total forces! All of $c's ships are safe, but things are getting really bad!」

683:t_000:2.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「But the galactic center is right ahead! We'll hold firm here!」
